hypothesis: The Qwen slot readout collapses spatial predictions under the small perception-only budget; falling auxiliary loss alone does not verify BEV perception. A spatially indexed dense readout separates provider learnability from slow slot assignment.

evidence.observation: predicted centres cluster around x 5-7 m, y 1 m

experiment: Fresh calibrated provider plus lightweight dense class/box head; 600 optimizer steps, lr 3e-4, same 64 training scenes, no future labels; evaluate fixed 0.2 score threshold/class-correct 2 m match before and after.
geometry_fix: Reject nonpositive radial scale or nonmonotonic Brown-Conrady polynomial branch, which can otherwise fold off-axis rays into the image. Provider metadata now calibrated_multiplane_v2.
core_models: No slot architecture change. D/E use the same final provider weights; dense auxiliary head not deployed.
selection_data: training only; no development or navtest adaptation
